results.title: JFK Jr.
results.overview: The story of John F. Kennedy Jr. and his life from 1968 until his tragic death in 1999.

results.title: Ghosts
results.overview: During an all-night train trip, Jaśmina shares a compartment with Andrzej - a mysterious, older man. At first a conservative and reserved acquaintance evolves into a tender, empathetic and understanding relationship between two alien souls.

results.title: A Family
results.overview: Caught in the crossfire of their parents’ divorce, Nina and Eli are torn between loyalty, anger and a longing to be seen. Through their mirrored perspectives the same story unfolds, revealing how love can fracture and still find its way.

results.title: AEW All Out 2026: The Buy In
results.original_title: AEW All Out 2026: The Buy In
results.overview: Renee Paquette, Mick Foley, Jeff Jarrett and RJ City are joined by a revolving lineup of AEW stars and special guests to preview All Out 2026. Interviews, predictions and backstage appearances set the stage for the pay-per-view, while Harley Cameron and Kris Statlander deliver an unforgettable musical update.

results.title: Joke
results.overview: Short immortalising Barry Cryer's 10 favourite jokes.

results.title: The Pervert's Guide to Utopias
results.overview: Philosopher Slavoj Žižek is our guide through landscapes of classic film, music, social media, archive and webcasts. Making unexpected twists and turns, he maps the utopian illusions of our times. Through absurd juxtapositions and startling insights, we are seduced into recognising our fate, in order to change it.

results.title: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
results.original_title: The Fall of Sir Douglas Weatherford
results.overview: In the Scottish village of Arberloch, Kenneth, a grieving tour guide, is devoted to preserving the legacy of the town's sole historical figure—eighteenth-century inventor Sir Douglas Weatherford. But when a fantasy series chooses Arberloch as its filming location, and the town turns its back on Weatherford in favour of fan culture, Kenneth descends into madness.

results.title: Operation Sindoor: A Nation's Resolve
results.overview: To commemorate the anniversary of Operation Sindoor, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh released a documentary film on Operation Sindoor . Iit talks about the nefarious designs of Pakistan over a period of time, against the innocent people of India, and India's national resolve to strike back with precision and accuracy without collateral damage. The whole nation approaches jointness, self-reliance, and indigenisation, ensuring victory. It projects a shining example of political will and integration of forces

results.title: Livin'
results.overview: The great war — in all its manifestations of death and the thirst for life, the sorrow of loss and the happiness of those who survived, the relationships between friends and enemies, children and parents, people and animals, entire worlds — cannot be captured in a single story. That is why this film will unfold in several novellas, united by the theme of war that has become our life.

results.title: Collision Theory
results.overview: On her way to the opportunity of a lifetime, an overly careful astrophysicist teacher finds herself stuck on a plane in a turbulent debate with a passionate flat-earther.

results.title: Bố Già Trở Lại
results.overview: The film follows Đằng, a former undercover operative who believed his blood-soaked past was behind him, only to be forced back into a brutal war when his daughter, Yến, is suddenly kidnapped. Her rescue becomes not only a relentless fight against uncompromising evil, but also a deeply personal journey of redemption and emotional reconciliation, as Đằng confronts the fractures and losses within his own family.

results.title: Conrad & Crab – Idiotic Gems
results.overview: Two less-than-splendid members of the judicial police of Perpignan arrive in the small town of Sainte-Marie-aux-Mines to watch over activities at the local gem market fair. In investigating a seemingly trivial matter, they stumble onto a potentially bigger criminal network.

results.title: KillTonyMania
results.overview: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

results.title: Souvenir
results.overview: A chance encounter between old friends Kevin and Dani leads to an unexpected day-long adventure through New York City as they attempt to return a stranger’s lost wallet, forcing them to confront unresolved feelings and life-changing decisions.

results.title: Shadow in the Desert
results.overview: An unknown creature haunts a young woman struggling with addiction after she steals a relic tainted with sinister energy.

results.title: Feigning Tennis
results.overview: An amateur tennis player must keep up the facade of being a pro to delay her wedding to a man she’s fallen out of love with. If her career takes off, she can excuse herself from the relationship with the promise of bigger and better things, even though it might reveal she was leading him on, but if she fails, she’d rather be in a one-sided marriage than completely alone. How far will she feign tennis success before the truth comes out?

results.title: Margherita, mozzarelle and Fanta
results.overview: Giulio is a young adult trapped in a routine of precarious jobs and distant relationships. Torn between the weight of family expectations and his struggle to accept a life off the traditional tracks, Giulio drifts between tense conversations with his brother Andrea and lonely evenings working as a delivery rider for a small pizzeria. During a delivery to an enigmatic customer, Maurizio, an apparently insignificant event—an unexpected whisper—casts a shadow of mystery over Giulio’s daily monotony, opening space for reflections on his condition and the choices that have led him there.

results.title: Strand 45
results.overview: A young woman with a painful past discovers her DNA holds the cure to cancer, instantly making her the most valuable secret on earth. As powerful interests close in, and her past haunts her, she must choose between her own safety and well-being, or risking everything to share her secret with the world.
